title: Grouparoo Error-Rate Trend Anomaly
app: Grouparoo run events via the Grouparoo API/logs to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=grouparoo:run
| bin _time span=1h
| stats count as events, sum(eval(state="failed")) as errors by _time
| eval error_rate=round(100*errors/events,2)
| eventstats avg(error_rate) as avg_rate, stdev(error_rate) as sd_rate
| where error_rate>avg_rate+3*sd_rate
| sort - _time
description: Baselines the hourly error rate for Grouparoo and flags hours where it spikes more than three standard deviations above normal, catching emerging instability before it becomes an outage.
value: An error-rate spike is the earliest signal that Grouparoo is degrading; statistical baselining suppresses routine noise and pages only on genuine anomalies.
implementation: Ingest Grouparoo logs into index=bi; schedule every 15 minutes over a trailing window and alert on 3-sigma error-rate anomalies.
visualization: Timechart of Grouparoo error rate with anomaly band.
grandmaExplanation: We learn what a normal amount of Grouparoo errors looks like and warn you only when something is genuinely going wrong.
